style: Cinematic film still, photoreal, shot on ARRI Alexa 65, anamorphic lens. An ancient sandstone temple courtyard at golden hour: carved stone arches and columns with deep weathering, moss in the cracks, heavy velvet banners in crimson, emerald and royal blue with gold embroidery, bronze hanging braziers on chains. Volumetric god rays through warm haze, dust motes, soft bounce light, rich micro detail, subtle film grain.

shots.prompt: a lone knight in weathered ivory plate armour stops in the middle of the hall, standing still, breathing
seen from behind and below, the knight stands small under the enormous vaulted arcade, looking up at light falling through the vault
